newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedbank says to take 9.1 percent of HSB Bank.
newsitem.headline: Swedbank says to take 9.1 percent of HSB Bank.

text.p: Swedish bank Swedbank said on Tuesday it signed a letter of intent to cooperate with cooperative real estate company HSB Sverige AB and said it intended to take a 9.1 percent stake in HSB Bank.
It said it would buy the stake by subscribing for shares in a new issue and that it had a conditional call option for a further 3.4 percent stake.

"Swedbank and HSB have had close cooperation for many years," Swedbank said, adding it was a natural development that it would take a stake in HSB Bank, which will start up in October and become a bank for co-operative flats.
The two banks will cooperate on clearing, technique, fund operations and first mortgages, HSB said in a statement.
"It is a strength for HSB Bank to get Swedbank as part owner," Christer Malm, president of HSB Sverige, said in the statement.
HSB Bank will become a subsidiary of HSB Sverige. It will have restricted equity of more than 450 million crowns ($56 million) and a balance sheet total of about nine billion crowns, HSB said.
The HSB group has 570,000 members and in 2000 it expects to have 50 percent of the total co-operative flat production and a total market share of at least 10 percent of all new Swedish housing.
The deal is subject to approval by authorities.
Swedbank is about to merge with Foreningsbanken into ForeningsSparbanken. ($ = 8.015 Swedish Crowns)
